item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - L7 - The Complete Collection
item.description:
#L7 Megapost

Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.
Been awhile since I dropped an entire collection. Here is all the L7 audio and some video at my fingertips. Most should have easily accessible info files. Please note Jennifer Finch is not on any 1996-2000 shows. I did include a few of her projects as I could find them. By no means a completist and don't really listen anymore except when I see them and transfer the show. 1994-1997 favorite era.

Still looking for Fairfax High 1993 and The Garage 1998 - I know someone who filmed it but it's a challenge to connect. The other 2 Whisky 1994 shows would be nice if they ever surfaced because the first 2 was all I could manage and they were great shows.

Also highly recommend this channel -

has lots of mostly later era

At some point this will disappear and who knows how easy it will be to gather again so share freely with other fans.

(I am not very sentimental and resist the urge to turn my feed into the obituaries but been meaning to do this for awhile)
